SEO SERVICE SCOPE

What Can £125 Per Month Get You in SEO Services?

See exactly what Cyberfreak Software’s £125 monthly SEO Management service includes and where extra work is separate.

By Cyberfreak Software · 28 November 2026

A defined monthly service

A £125 monthly budget needs a focused scope. Cyberfreak Software’s SEO Management service is intended for businesses that want regular oversight of search foundations and clear recommendations without committing to a broad agency programme.

What is included

The service includes Google Search Console setup and verification, XML sitemap submission and maintenance, monitoring of clicks, impressions and indexed pages, query analysis and keyword opportunity review, practical content recommendations and a monthly SEO performance report. The report helps you understand what the available data shows and what could be worth addressing next.

What is not included in the monthly fee

The service does not include writing and publishing blog posts, ongoing website development, major technical fixes or a guarantee of rankings, traffic or enquiries. If the review identifies a change that needs implementation, we can discuss it separately with a clear scope. This keeps recommendations distinct from production work and avoids implying unlimited development.

Who may find it useful

It may suit a small business with an existing website and someone available to review or implement recommendations. It is less suitable if you need a full content team, extensive development or a large-scale campaign included in one monthly fee. Start by describing what your site needs and checking whether the included work addresses it.

Terms and next step

The service is £125 per month, has no minimum subscription term and can be cancelled at any time. Read the SEO Management pricing and service details, or send an enquiry about your website.
